Corollary
[Derivative estimates from an initial curvature bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0260 ↗ thm:chow-ii-global-curvature-derivative-estimates ↗ lem:chow-ii-curvature-doubling-time 1. ch14:14.7\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

For $m,n\in \mathbb N$, there is $C(m,n)$ such that, whenever the maximum principle applies and $|\operatorname {Rm}(g(0))|\le K$, \[ |\nabla ^m\operatorname {Rm}(x,t)|\le \frac{C(m,n)K}{t^{m/2}} \qquad \left(0<t\le \frac1{16K}\right). \]
Proof

\sketch Lemma 2 bounds the curvature by $2K$ on the stated interval. Apply Theorem 2 with this bound and a fixed dimensionless time parameter.

□
